examples.title: Finding States on a Map
examples.problem: Locate a state in the North and one in the South of India.
steps: Look at the top part of the India map (North): Identify Jammu & Kashmir or Himachal Pradesh.
Look at the bottom part of the India map (South): Identify Tamil Nadu or Kerala.
Result: Himachal Pradesh is in the North, and Kerala is in the South.

examples.title: Celebrating Diversity
examples.problem: Name three different festivals celebrated across India.
steps: Identify a festival from the North/West: Diwali.
Identify a festival from the South: Onam or Pongal.
Identify a festival from the East: Durga Puja or Bihu.
Conclusion: India celebrates diverse festivals like Diwali, Onam, and Durga Puja.
